name: Blood seal
description: A paper seal painted in Jacob's blood that lets Millicent be heard and anchors her to her memories.

timeline.summary: The geist returns, and Jacob uses his own blood to draw a seal that lets her speak; she names herself Millicent and says a man used her community's spirits.
